papers.title: Total hip arthroplasty in idiopathic chondrolysis of the hip: A case report
papers.abstract: Chondrolysis of the hip is defined as an extensive loss of articular cartilage of the femoral head and acetabulum. A 14-year-old girl presented to our institute with pain of insidious onset in the right hip, associated with a limp since 18 months. On exam

summary_en.motivation: Presents a rare case of idiopathic chondrolysis of the hip treated with total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective case report with clinical examination and imaging.
summary_en.result: The patient experienced significant pain relief and functional improvement postoperatively.
